style.visual_direction: realistic industrial maintenance, restrained blue-green technology overlay, high-contrast presentation background, no readable text inside images

assets.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: widescreen presentation hero background for an equipment maintenance AI system. Primary request: a realistic industrial workshop scene with an electric motor, centrifugal pump, and bearing assembly on a clean maintenance bench, with a technician inspecting the equipment and a subtle translucent AI retrieval interface overlay made of abstract panels and connecting lines. Scene/backdrop: modern manufacturing maintenance bay, organized tools, safety signage shapes without legible words. Style/medium: polished photorealistic industrial editorial image with restrained technology overlay. Composition/framing: 16:9 widescreen, strong negative space on the left for slide title, equipment cluster on the right, cinematic but practical. Lighting/mood: cool daylight mixed with soft workshop lighting, professional, reliable, high-value competition presentation. Color palette: steel gray, deep blue, teal accents, small safety yellow highlights. Constraints: no readable text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no fantasy machinery, no unsafe behavior.

Constraints: no readable text, no logos, no watermarks, documents may contain abstract lines only, no human faces.
